flame_wave.name: Flame Wave
flame_wave.description: Short cone that burns nearby enemies.

saw_drone.name: Saw Drone
saw_drone.description: Large slow saw ball that travels in a straight line.

void_mine.name: Void Mine
void_mine.description: Drops a delayed trap at your feet.

meteor_pin.name: Meteor Pin
meteor_pin.description: Calls a strike on the nearest enemy.

acid_pool.name: Acid Pool
acid_pool.description: Leaves a damaging patch under enemies.

nova_burst.name: Nova Burst
nova_burst.description: Slow, wide blast around the player.

metaUpgrades.name: Max HP

runUpgrades.description: Collect XP from farther away this run.

runUpgrades.name: Max HP

runUpgrades.name: Attack Radius
runUpgrades.description: Increase projectile size and area reach for this run.

runUpgrades.name: Fire Rate

runUpgrades.name: Flat Damage
runUpgrades.description: Add fixed damage to every weapon hit this run.

runUpgrades.name: Split Fire
runUpgrades.description: Projectile weapons fire extra angled shots.

runUpgrades.name: Splinter Shots
runUpgrades.description: Projectile hits split into two smaller arrows.

use_laser_run.description: Fire Prism Beam during a run.
